description: Establish a green baseline before any code change. Install dependencies and confirm typecheck, lint, and the existing vitest suite (which includes src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx) all pass as-is. This records the starting state so later behavior changes can be attributed to the actual edits and not a pre-existing break. Independent of other features and must run first.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/wecare-digital, run `npm install` (node_modules may be absent). Node pinned in .nvmrc is 24; sandbox node is v22.23.3 - if install or a tool hard-fails solely on a node-version gate, record it in findings as a blocker rather than editing engines.
Run `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) and capture the result.
Run `npm run lint` (eslint .) and capture the result.
Run `npm run test` (vitest run) and capture the result; confirm src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx passes.

Record exact pass/fail (and any pre-existing failures unrelated to this task) in this feature's findings field so later features start from a known baseline. Do NOT modify application code in this feature.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` completes (or any blocker is clearly recorded in findings).
`npm run typecheck` result is recorded; passing is expected.
`npm run lint` result is recorded; passing is expected.
`npm run test` runs and the VayuLokLive suite result is recorded; passing is expected.
No application source files were modified by this feature.
findings:
Green baseline established on branch vayulok-retired-host-cleanup (no application source modified).

Non-blocking noise only: EBADENGINE warning (node 22 vs required >=24), a peer-dep warning for @xstate/react (react 18 peer under @aws-amplify/ui-react), deprecation notices (uuid@7, eslint@9.39.5), and npm audit reporting 8 vulnerabilities (3 moderate, 5 high). None affect verification.

npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit): PASS (exit 0, no output).

npm run lint (eslint .): PASS (exit 0). Reports 203 warnings, 0 ERRORS. Warnings are pre-existing and unrelated to this task (e.g. react-hooks/set-state-in-effect in src/pages/workspace/settings/internal-agent.tsx and src/pages/workspace/task/index.tsx; one unused eslint-disable directive in src/test/CartCheckout.test.tsx). eslint exits 0 because only warnings are present.

npm run test (vitest run): PASS (exit 0). 74 test files (73 passed, 1 skipped); 903 tests total (900 passed, 3 skipped). Duration ~20.7s.

TARGET SUITE src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx: PASS - 11 tests passed (verified both in the full run and via an isolated `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx` -> 1 file / 11 tests passed). This confirms the honest-degradation path (no key -> no Maps script, zero fetches) and the India-scoped map-wiring + forecast/history paths are green at baseline.

KNOWN NON-FAILURE NOISE for later features: vitest stderr prints `Received true for a non-boolean attribute jsx` from several styled-jsx components (VayuLokLive, BlogSubscribe, PhoneFieldSearch, etc.) - this is a benign React warning under jsdom, not a test failure. All suites still pass.

No application source files were modified in FEAT-001; only the task-state JSON under .agents/tasks/ was updated.
